headline: Tax breaks for sole proprietors in Ukraine: when the military levy does not have to be paid
summary: Certain sole proprietors, self-employed persons and servicemembers are exempt from paying the military levy. The exemption covers sole proprietors in single-tax groups one and two from combat zones, mobilized entrepreneurs, and some military incomes.
why: The military levy is a tax on income in Ukraine, so exemptions change the tax burden on small businesses and workers during wartime. Investors track such fiscal measures as signals of government revenue and labour-market conditions.
